rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: One eligible species, Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant), was recorded 842-850 m from the polygon, with lack of dead wood among its threats. None were recorded within 250 m.

Effort within 1000 m is adequate (121 records, 28 days, 67th percentile; county median 54). There are no kept records inside the polygon or within 250 m, but 5 coarse records within 250 m were dropped for uncertainty, so near-site coverage is weak.

Mobile threatened birds and a bat were recorded within 1000 m. They are supporting evidence only and do not drive the priority. The nearest is Aegolius funereus (EN), a 2016 record at 239 m with 400 m uncertainty.
Only 1.6% of the polygon overlaps completed felling, so it is not already felled.

uncertainties: The one eligible record is about 840 m away, so it says little about the polygon itself.
The 5 coarse records within 250 m were excluded, so they could not be assessed.
The notification states 0.4 ha of nature-forest area (natfor_ha), but this was not examined further.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs in the polygon.
The condition or age of the stand.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: A reviewer should check the stand's habitat, including the 0.4 ha natfor_ha figure, and the dead-wood and old-tree status. The reviewer should also look at the dropped coarse records within 250 m.
